voltage.evidence_quote: Nominal single-phase voltage in Chile is 220 volts AC

plug_types.evidence_quote: Chile standardizes on 3-pin in-line Type L sockets compatible with 2-pin Type C Europlugs

police.evidence_quote: Emergency police dispatch throughout Chile connects via 133

ambulance.evidence_quote: SAMU emergency ambulance and medical dispatch is dialed on 131

fire.evidence_quote: Firefighting rescue services across all Chilean municipalities respond to 132

general.evidence_quote: 133 serves as the primary emergency hotline for urgent public intervention in Chile

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Carabineros and SERNATUR provide coordinated tourist assistance via 133

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Chile ranks among the top 3 nations globally in fixed broadband speed averaging 262.4 Mbps

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Sıkı tarım ve biyogüvenlik kontrolleri (SAG) uygulanır; taze meyve, tohum veya organik ürünlerin ülkeye sokulması yasaktır ve gümrük beyannamesinde bildirilmelidir. Prizler 3 sıralı bacaklı Tip L standardındadır (Tip C Europlug uyar). Deprem anında sakin kalınmalı ve bina güvenliği talimatlarına uyulmalıdır.
